data.briefing: Over the past four days, Meridian pilot preparations progressed with sandbox API credentials issued to Vikram Rao's team and the SOC 2 Type II report delivered under a signed NDA. Technical teams resolved sandbox validation errors and mapped optional fields, while ongoing deliverables remain on track for upcoming November deadlines.
points: On Friday 30 October 2026, Karan Malhotra issued sandbox API credentials to Vikram Rao's team one week ahead of schedule, and Riya sent the SOC 2 Type II report.
Vikram Rao requested written confirmation that Meridian's data will be stored primarily in AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore.
On Thursday 29 October 2026, Meridian legal signed the mutual NDA late in the evening and the first weekly status call was held at 4 PM.
Meera identified an optional remitter VPA column in Meridian's sample file on 29 October, ensuring ingestion is not blocked.
On Wednesday 28 October 2026, Sanjay Desai named Pooja Menon and Imran Qureshi as the two UAT analysts ahead of the 13 November date.
Arjun's first anonymised sample file failed validation on 28 October due to date formats, but Karan pulled sandbox logs so Arjun could fix it.
